name: Are there any specific photo requirements for roof damage claims in DFW?

mainEntity.name: Are there any specific photo requirements for roof damage claims in DFW?

acceptedAnswer.text: While specific photo requirements can vary by insurance provider, the general recommendation in the DFW area and elsewhere is to provide clear, high-resolution images that accurately depict the damage. This includes both overall roof shots and close-ups of specific issues. Providing dated photos is always beneficial. Our team operating in the DFW area is familiar with common insurance company expectations for photo documentation.
acceptedAnswer.description: In DFW, clear, high-resolution, and dated photos of both overall roof and specific damage are generally required by insurance providers.
